title.fr_fr: Fragment de minerai de terres rares

content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table : 9 x fragment (rare).
- Furnace (x16) : Meteor Rare Earth Ore.

Used to make :
[[Boron|Boron Fragment]], [[gv:fragment_lanthanium|Lanthanium Fragment]], [[gv:fragment_cobalt|Cobalt Fragment]], [[gv:fragment_cerium|Cerium Fragment]], [[gv:fragment_neodymium|Neodymium Fragment]], [[gv:fragment_niobium|Niobium Fragment]], [[gv:powder_cobalt_tiny|Tiny Pile of Cobalt Powder]], [[gv:powder_boron_tiny|Tiny Pile of Boron Powder]], [[gv:powder_niobium_tiny|Tiny Pile of Niobium Powder]], [[gv:nugget_zirconium|Zirconium Splinter]] and 1 more.
